review_notes: Corrected two units and removed one: the הָיָה frame now carries the apodosis complementizer at t019 (rules 25, 45), the infinitive construct הַנְחִילוֹ now carries the temporal clause's relative at t008 (rule 52), and the added unit that held t019 is gone. Nothing else in the verse changed.

The competing reading is the accepted one, which read t008 as the frame's 'that' and t019 as a subordinator supplied for the לֹא יוּכַל clause under rule 55. It is rejected because the apodosis of the וְהָיָה frame is 'he may not make the son of the beloved the first born', so t019 is the word the frame writes before it, and because 'in the day that he causeth' is the same shape as rule 52's 'in the day when they shall make it', where the temporal word belongs to the infinitive and not to the frame. DEU.21.3 aligns the same frame with its complementizer on the apodosis.
All 29 source ids and all 42 target ids are partitioned exactly once across the 28 units, and every head is a member of its own array.
